own_check.proof_read: whole source statement and complete proof, including every concluding derivation
own_check.details: Re-derived the contracting torus Koszul complex for each nontrivial deck character. The finite torus cover retains that nontrivial character because gcd(d,12)=1; averaging then kills the finite-filling cohomology. Checked the normalization B(lambda) rank3 and degree4 contribution and the ordinary trivial-character AC26 contribution. No integral torsion conclusion is inferred from the character computation.

own_check.details: Read every line and independently followed the lifted finite affine lattice and Bezout meridian normalization p/d=±1. own_check.details: Checked the explicit admissible representative (0,-d,d), p=d and pprime1, the two invariant translation vectors, and all affine matrices. Independently verified the deck displacement differences are integral for every d. Finite central fixed points force d|a by coprimality, while a nonzero cusp period cannot stabilize a finite toric cell. The quotient restores precisely the original lattice and twists. Lift of the established oriented quotient diffeomorphism intertwines deck actions up to a group automorphism; the theorem only classifies actions in this constructed family. The final sphere-family claims are restricted to d=1.

own_check.details: Re-derived the arbitrary 3k/4l free affine quotient and primitive Bezout meridians. Van Kampen reduces to P=m1*n0+m0*n1. The full degree-one map has equal rank9 and kernel rank0 or1 according as P is nonzero or zero. Checked the primitive exterior splitting, both normal-torus columns, and the remaining matrix [[-2n0,-3n1],[-k,2l]]: entry gcd1, determinant -P. Its zero-determinant case gives the extra free summand; UCT/PD gives every stated group. Entire certificate read and rerun identically. The original Viaclovsky logarithm paper §4 assumed P=±1; this integral argument is a genuine extension of that scope.

# Independent audit of D.2.44

The current full section `sections/fourfolds_D2_critical_frame.tex` was read
on 16 November 2026, including the added localization argument and the
explicit surgery models. The audit passes within its stated seven-row,
primitive-Mumford, no-extra-regular-log scope.

The C_c localization is integral in Z/c because all nontrivial isotropy
is the full group and the remaining action is free. The mixed elliptic
class has square zero even when the degree-one cyclic class squares
nontrivially: the elliptic degree-one class lifts integrally and has square
zero. The determinant character vanishes, so the λ=-c2 computation has no
unrecorded determinant term. The resulting λ=μ=0 leaves exactly the stated
binary refined class.

Brown's original pp.369–372 were visually read from the cached original
page images. F(u,0) on p.369 is the stabilization of u itself. The duality
construction in Theorem1.7/Corollary1.11 sends a normal-framed collapse to
the induced stable framed class. Lemma1.2 and the remark after
Corollary1.13 identify the target and the odd quaternionic Hopf element.
Thus the parity comparison for a torus and a sphere in the same mod-two
class is valid, including an integral torsion class. The sphere convention
agrees with the left-quaternionic clutch and with Zhubr2013 §5. The P=0
converse is also valid: the admissible field's spin three-plane complement
has its primary obstruction zero, and H5(X minus point;Z/2)=0 removes the
only remaining obstruction on a five-dimensional spine.

The differential complex, its unit Bott residue, abstract nonvanishing
δ-vector and upper-triangular reference-frame comparison have an
independent geometric verification in `code/maps_D2_frame_proof.tex`.
That proof additionally constructs a spin-compatible ambient surgery
T³→S³ directly in X minus a point, using Kaplan's original Theorem3.1;
it does not assume a spin-insensitive Borromean surgery. Its direct
Spin6/Spin3 transgression supplies an independent obstruction comparison.

The seven-row critical-cycle proof was read in full, and the actual
`manifolds_even_critical_cycles.py` was rerun independently. Both ordinary
clutch signs passed for all rows. The integral transverse bases, the
unimodular cusp support-degree matrix and the extra dual-torus coordinate
identify the literal critical cycles. The boundary-chain extraction gives
the integer links ±4 and ±37,±7,±27 and certifies the odd generator.

For the model recognition, Zhubr's original English paper was reopened
through MathNet (`turn443view0`, `turn444view0`–`turn444view2`). Theorem3,
printed p.795, gives uniqueness of the oriented simply connected b3=0
manifold over K(G,2). The natural bordism homomorphism P is defined in
§1.4, p.796; §3.13, pp.807–808, proves its agreement with the manifold
invariant. Theorem5, p.796, makes (P,μ) complete, and §3.12 gives
P(CP³)=1. Hence the conic surgery has P=1 mod2, and the map
Z/2⊕Z→Z/c sending (t,z) to (c/2,1) kills (t,-c/2). Its surgery trace
therefore transports P to c/2. The complete cubic maps to zero for c4/8.
The zero model has P=μ=0. Both sphere normal bundles are trivial by spin,
and π2SO4=0 gives their unique normal framings. This validates the actual
stated surgery models, rather than recognizing the types by homology.

The later type-II or good-log extension is a separate problem. In
particular, the regular three-torus can be an even class after a good
logarithmic replacement; D.2.44 itself does not make that extension.

# Frame comparison supporting D.2.44

The unnumbered proof is `code/maps_D2_frame_proof.tex`. It is an independently
auditable input for the fourfolds-owned theorem, not a duplicate register row.

## Primary sources inspected

Steve J. Kaplan, *Constructing framed 4-manifolds with given almost framed
boundaries*, Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. **254** (1979), 237–263,
DOI 10.1090/S0002-9947-1979-0539917-X.

The original journal scan was opened through the primary-paper mirror at
https://scispace.com/pdf/constructing-framed-4-manifolds-with-given-almost-framed-1vq4kmmbg3.pdf
The verified source is the complete 27-page original journal scan.
The publisher URL returned HTTP 403, which is an access result only.
A guessed Ranicki `kaplan.pdf` download was initially assigned the local
cache name, then rejected on inspecting its first page: it was Kaplan's
different 1982 knot paper. It is not evidence for this theorem, and its
external cache files have been renamed `maps_kaplan82_slice.pdf` and `.txt`.
Direct HTTP download of the correct mirror returned an empty response;
the full primary text and screenshots were instead inspected through
the web PDF reader. No local 1979 PDF is claimed at this stage.

Exact locations read: Definition 1.7 and Remark 1.8, printed p.239; the
relative second-Stiefel–Whitney obstruction paragraph and Definition 1.10,
p.240; Theorem 3.1 and its complete constructive proof, pp.243–246;
Example 3.2, p.246. The introduction on p.237 explicitly states that the
constructed fillings have one zero-handle and all other handles of index
two. Remark 1.8 identifies almost framings with the specified H1(-;Z/2)
choice. Example 3.2 explicitly distinguishes the exceptional spin structure
on T³ with index-eight filling. These are exactly the features needed for
the spin-compatible ambient surgery, and exclude a tacit use of the wrong
Borromean spin structure.

Web retrievals: `turn434view0`, `turn437view0`, `turn437view1`.

A. V. Zhubr, *On the definition of the exotic invariant for simply connected
closed six-dimensional spin manifolds*, Izvestia Komi **4(16)** (2013), 4–10,
was read from the full original issue already cached externally as
`primary_Zhubr13_issue.pdf` and `.txt`.
Lemma 1, printed p.5, gives π3(V6,3)=Z/2, π4(V6,3)=0 and the index-two map
π3(SO3)→π3(SO5). Theorem 1, p.6, identifies the obstruction for fields
nontrivial relative to embedded torsion spheres; Section 5, pp.8–9,
supplies the actual quaternionic surgery proof. Conjecture 1 on p.6 is
explicitly *not* invoked. Instead, the Spin6/Spin3 Serre transgression proves
the required Bockstein identity for the globally trivial ambient bundle on
the punctured manifold.

## Exact checks and remaining audit

`code/maps_D2_frame_checks.py` verifies the actual xy and xyz syzygies,
the Hilbert–Burch maximal minors at the triple point, the unit Bott matrix,
and all seven row parities. It does not substitute for the embedded
spin-surgery argument. The latter is given in full in the proof and was
sent to root and fourfolds for independent review before integration.

# Independent D.2.45 geometric inputs and relative-class audit

The full parent proof code/root_critical_link_refined_P_proof.tex was
read independently. Its relative-class calculation passes, with the
sphere-selection order now explicit in the source:

1. First form a genuine normal-framed ambient cobordism from the chosen
   three-manifold (or an odd number of copies) to an embedded sphere
   representing the full two-primary generator.
2. Then choose Zhubr's admissible three-frame for that particular sphere.
   Its Spin3 complement can be framed over the trace relative to the
   incoming boundary, since the trace has only one/two-handles.
3. The reference complement frame is spin-compatible because the
   complement of the real-codimension-four critical cycle is simply
   connected. Both induced three-manifold framed classes are even, so
   their Spin6 comparison has even integral degree.
4. Relative stabilization is multiplication by two on the Spin3
   obstruction, and the actual complex critical cycle represents minus
   the relative lambda class. Pairing the identity with a chain bounding
   c times the three-manifold retains the integer ambiguity and proves
   the stated rational linking formula. No division by two in an even
   cyclic group is used.

The local derivative input is code/maps_D2_II_frame_proof.tex.
At the original type-II cap, the map is y²-x³ times the scalar direction,
the critical ideal is (x²,y), and the explicit normalized SU2 clutch has
degree two. The actual critical cycle is 2E_II. At a free good-reduction
logarithmic cap of order m, dividing df by its common (m−1)D factor gives
the target L0(-(m−1)D) and the surjective map m ds on the etale total
cover. The corrected critical cycle is empty. No assumption of
isotriviality or of a free action on an unverified model is made. The
type-II linearization zero is elsewhere. Exact local checks are in
code/maps_D2_II_frame_checks.py/.out.

The actual finite-core reference parity and the preferred full generator
are proved in code/maps_D2_finite_generator_frame.tex. Kaplan's
spin-compatible zero/two-handle filling gives actual tangent-framing
parity 1+b1(N;F2). For the finite-II mapping torus this is zero.
The corrected target line gives the true complex normal direction,
and projection along the transverse delta vector converts the global
vertical reference frame to an actual tangent three-frame.

The preferred primitive character is

    chi(delta)=1, chi(ell)=-sigma*r, chi(g)=-sigma*r*e,
    sigma=n-m*e=±1.

It respects m*g=r*delta+n*ell. Its kernel has order-six elliptic
monodromy B^sigma. More importantly, the D.2.30 reduced Thom columns
have pairings (1,-sigma*r,0), including the nonzero root-loop term
before the column change Kg-e*Kell. Thus b*s bounds with pairing
sigma, so this N is a full H3 generator even when b=20. Root
independently checked these identities; the six-manifolds agent is
replaying the full integral marked matrix with the root-loop term.
The earlier character with chi(g)=0 was valid but needlessly lost
some odd-primary information and is not used in the final input.

# Frame comparison supporting D.2.44

The unnumbered proof is `code/maps_D2_frame_proof.tex`. It is an independently
auditable input for the fourfolds-owned theorem, not a duplicate register row.

## Primary sources inspected

Steve J. Kaplan, *Constructing framed 4-manifolds with given almost framed
boundaries*, Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. **254** (1979), 237–263,
DOI 10.1090/S0002-9947-1979-0539917-X.

The original journal scan was opened through the primary-paper mirror at
https://scispace.com/pdf/constructing-framed-4-manifolds-with-given-almost-framed-1vq4kmmbg3.pdf
The verified source is the complete 27-page original journal scan.
The publisher URL returned HTTP 403, which is an access result only.
A guessed Ranicki `kaplan.pdf` download was initially assigned the local
cache name, then rejected on inspecting its first page: it was Kaplan's
different 1982 knot paper. It is not evidence for this theorem, and its
external cache files have been renamed `maps_kaplan82_slice.pdf` and `.txt`.
Direct HTTP download of the correct mirror returned an empty response;
the full primary text and screenshots were instead inspected through
the web PDF reader. No local 1979 PDF is claimed at this stage.

Exact locations read: Definition 1.7 and Remark 1.8, printed p.239; the
relative second-Stiefel–Whitney obstruction paragraph and Definition 1.10,
p.240; Theorem 3.1 and its complete constructive proof, pp.243–246;
Example 3.2, p.246. The introduction on p.237 explicitly states that the
constructed fillings have one zero-handle and all other handles of index
two. Remark 1.8 identifies almost framings with the specified H1(-;Z/2)
choice. Example 3.2 explicitly distinguishes the exceptional spin structure
on T³ with index-eight filling. These are exactly the features needed for
the spin-compatible ambient surgery, and exclude a tacit use of the wrong
Borromean spin structure.

Web retrievals: `turn434view0`, `turn437view0`, `turn437view1`.

A. V. Zhubr, *On the definition of the exotic invariant for simply connected
closed six-dimensional spin manifolds*, Izvestia Komi **4(16)** (2013), 4–10,
was read from the full original issue already cached externally as
`primary_Zhubr13_issue.pdf` and `.txt`.
Lemma 1, printed p.5, gives π3(V6,3)=Z/2, π4(V6,3)=0 and the index-two map
π3(SO3)→π3(SO5). Theorem 1, p.6, identifies the obstruction for fields
nontrivial relative to embedded torsion spheres; Section 5, pp.8–9,
supplies the actual quaternionic surgery proof. Conjecture 1 on p.6 is
explicitly *not* invoked. Instead, the Spin6/Spin3 Serre transgression proves
the required Bockstein identity for the globally trivial ambient bundle on
the punctured manifold.

## Exact checks and remaining audit

`code/maps_D2_frame_checks.py` verifies the actual xy and xyz syzygies,
the Hilbert–Burch maximal minors at the triple point, the unit Bott matrix,
and all seven row parities. It does not substitute for the embedded
spin-surgery argument. The latter is given in full in the proof and was
sent to root and fourfolds for independent review before integration.

# Independent D.2.48 audit

Status: **passed**, 16 November 2026. This is an independent proof read by the fourfolds agent, with the exact algebra program rerun.

## Files read

- `code/maps_weighted_engel_invariants_proof.tex`
- `code/maps_weighted_engel_mu_proof.tex`
- `code/manifolds_weighted_engel_proof.tex` (the already audited D.2.34 input)
- `sections/fourfolds_D48_thomas.tex`
- `code/maps_weighted_engel_invariants.py`

## Geometric and integral checks

The relative component-meridian calculation gives the primitive relation among the component classes. The complement has free H1, so the zero-rank quotient in H2 cohomology has no hidden torsion. The restriction formula and connected component graph make component restriction injective, proving integral c1=0. The corrected differential removes the genuine multiple-fibre divisor before the critical cycle is used. The locally free abstract kernel has its nonzero scalar section; this is not a claim that its image vector field is nonzero at a critical point.

The literal critical cycle is transferred only across the actual core/cusp period cover. Its image is -5d times the primitive ruling and is zero integrally. The finite cap is not incorrectly treated as a cover. The actual order-four core has H1=Z plus Z2, so every actual tangent parallelization has odd stable-framing parity. Its exact critical link is 5kP, also odd. The restored parity term in the relative characteristic formula cancels this link, giving refined P=0. This remains valid with free H2 because 2P=0 kills the free part and the critical cycle is nullhomologous.

## Global cyclic coordinate and full detectors

The weight-one integral core class is fixed on all six homology generators. Its cusp boundary value agrees on both the fibre quotient and the two actual bounding angular sweeps; H1 of that boundary is free. Pullback along the degree-d cover therefore matches the whole boundary cohomology, including the new Ext term. The finite-cap Gysin values are evaluated on all actual generators a, gamma, and the root g; they are (-2dn0,-6dr0,0) and (-3dn1,-6dr1,0). Their vanishing modulo d kills the entire extension obstruction. The resulting global u has the stated integral component restriction eta=(-5,6,0,-1).

The component restriction gives the mixed Pontryagin-square value -12 modulo 2d for even d. The equivariant scalar weights differ by six; Thomas localization gives the full pure Pontryagin cube zero modulo 3d for 3-divisible d, not only its reduction modulo d.

Whitehead's primary exact sequence and quadratic-group calculation give H4(K(Z/d,2))=Z/(d gcd(d,2)). Zhubr's primary surjectivity and free-bordism calculation make H6 cyclic generated by reduced CP3; its two-primary obstruction vanishes explicitly in Section3.12. The classes dh on CP3 and dx+y on CP1 x CP2 impose the two relations d^3 and 3d, whose gcd is d gcd(d,3). The ordinary cube or Thomas operation evaluates one on the generator and proves the opposite bound. The product with (CP-infinity)^(d-1) has no Kunneth Tor terms. Thus all displayed coordinates are perfect detectors of the complete fundamental-class invariant, and Zhubr's classification is applied with all its inputs.

## Primary sources independently opened

- J. H. C. Whitehead, *The Secondary Boundary Operator* (1950), Theorem1 and Section2, original PDF: https://webhomes.maths.ed.ac.uk/~v1ranick/papers/jhcw10.pdf . The source explicitly treats infinite complexes and gives the odd/even cyclic quadratic-group orders.
- A. V. Zhubr, *Classification of Simply Connected Six-Dimensional Spinor Manifolds* (1975), Lemmas3.7 and3.11 and Section3.12, primary English journal PDF: https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=im&option_lang=rus&paperid=2054&what=fullteng . Web primary text was read; an attempted direct cache download returned HTTP403 and no local PDF was created.
- Thomas1956 was independently read from the original scan in the preceding pure-operation proof, including coefficients in (2.1), the integral-cocycle formula (3.4), and the detecting value (2.8).

## Executed verification

Independent command: `python code/maps_weighted_engel_invariants.py > records/fourfolds_weighted_engel_peer_audit.out`. Exit0. It passed the universal polynomial bounding-chain, period-cover and Gysin identities; support wall degrees and eta square; 264 supplementary finite-core cases; and component Laplacians for d=1 through50. Universal claims use the symbolic identities and geometric proofs, not extrapolation from these finite bounds. The separate Thomas program proves its two all-parameter polynomial identities and checks 4920 supplementary integer cases.

# D.2.48: source locations and exact scope

The theorem is the simply connected sector of the **actual weighted Engel
profile IV*, III, I1**, with both additive caps replaced by good logarithmic
caps. It includes every positive weight d and every pair of finite orders
3k, 4l and marked twists with determinant ±1. It does not assert a smooth
classification for original additive caps, further regular logarithms, or
arbitrary weighted profiles.

## Primary sources checked

- **A. V. Zhubr (1975), Math. USSR Izvestija 9, 793–812.**
  The original English primary PDF was reopened on 16 November 2026 from
  https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=im&option_lang=rus&paperid=2054&what=fullteng
  (web references turn450view0, turn451view0–2, turn453view0).
  Definitions of the complete invariants: §1.2, pp.794–795.
  Smooth classification: Theorem 1, p.795.
  Spin-bordism fundamental-class image: Lemma 3.7 and (3.4), pp.805–806.
  Epimorphism on coefficient groups: Lemma 3.11, pp.806–807.
  Free generators epsilon and reduced CP3, and the explicit equality
  ker(alpha)=H6=Z/(2^a) for a two-power coefficient group: §3.12, p.807.
  The general cyclic H6 order is derived in the new proof, not quoted
  from an unverified table: its generator has both d^3 and 3d relations,
  and the ordinary/Thomas cube supplies the matching lower bound.
  Direct local download returned HTTP403; no local PDF is claimed.

- **E. Thomas (1956), PNAS 42, 266–269.**
  The actual primary scans/OCR are outside the deliverable archive at
  ../external_cache/primary_Thomas56.pdf and the corresponding page files.
  Equation (2.1), p.267, has coefficients Z/(p m) to Z/(p^2 m);
  hence it applies to every even d for the square and every 3-divisible d
  for the cube, with the full moduli 2d and 3d.
  Equation (2.8), p.267, gives the projective-space generator evaluation.
  The cochain formula (3.4), p.268, reduces to the ordinary power on an
  integral cocycle. Fourfolds independently reread these primary lines
  and supplied the full scalar-circle localization proof and certificate.

- **J. H. C. Whitehead (1950), PNAS 36, 55–60.**

constructed fillings have one zero-handle and all other handles of index
two. Remark 1.8 identifies almost framings with the specified H1(-;Z/2)
choice. Example 3.2 explicitly distinguishes the exceptional spin structure
on T³ with index-eight filling. These are exactly the features needed for

# Bounded adversarial audit of D.2.49, SL17--SL24

Status: **passed**. This audit concerns the decisive integral order-two marking, not a second execution of the full star-cap program. Root owns the complete theorem audit.

For B(beta)=-beta-n lambda and B(lambda)=lambda, the Wang kernel is generated by lambda and the exterior-area cokernel has order two. Thus H2 of the classifying group is Z z plus Z2 t. The actual quadratic bar correction is -n binom(u_beta,2)t. Over 2k returns, exactly k of the beta vectors have coefficient -1, so the total correction is -kn t, while the norm is -kn lambda. Substituting ell=2k kappa-a0R lambda adds -a0R t. This verifies the whole SL18 formula, including its previously invisible term.

The endpoint loop calculation is literal: for odd a0, (beta g)^a0=beta+a0 g-n(a0-1)lambda/2. After the Bezout replacement this is beta+kappa-n(a0-1)lambda/2, so the two conductor tori are z and z-t. Therefore their difference is the nonzero cap torsion class. For k even, n,R,a0 odd, the primitive w maps to -kz+t and x maps to t. Combining these with the already computed free images forces both tau terms in SL20.

The normal torus delta/g is entirely in the commuting lambda/kappa subgroup because delta=2lambda and g=N kappa+b0Rlambda. Its class is 2Nz. Similarly the ell/g torus is -(2kb0+a0N)Rz=-Rz. Neither carries a t term. The absence of torsion here follows from the actual subgroup map, not from a rational equation.

Changing the marked integer lift by j -> j+hq replaces L by L-hn w. It consequently introduces h tau in its cap image. The free kernel equation already forces the coefficient of L to be even, since k is even and R odd. Thus the additional torsion term vanishes exactly when forming the displayed full kernel, leaving the required parity condition on the w coefficient. # Independent D.2.50 audit

Status: **passed**. The full source `code/root_vertical_corrections_proof.tex` and revised executable `code/root_vertical_corrections.py` were independently read. No root-owned file was changed.

## Local integral geometry

The matrices retain both edges of I2/III, the actual multiplicity vectors of the starred fibres, and the marked component permutations from D.2.22. For every matrix J, its radical is the primitive whole-fibre vector and its rank is one less than the number of components. The finite permutation preserves J and this vector. The multidegree c=e_p-e_0 is literal section intersection, with both section components of multiplicity one. Pullback reverses the permutation, but its fixed subspace and full integral solution set are unchanged.

For I_n the quotient of degree-zero vectors by the cycle Laplacian has order n, detected by sum(i c_i). Translation by q has gcd(n,q) orbits, so the invariant multidegrees represent precisely (n/gcd(n,q))Z/n. This proves the condition n divides p*q. The finite starred and exceptional types are exhaustively checked, with explicit integer obstructions on all negative cases.

The ambiguity lemma is exact integrally: if J(sigma-I)z=0, then (sigma-I)z=h m with h integral because m is primitive. The finite norm annihilates the left side and equals the positive permutation order times h m on the right. Thus h=0. The complete ambiguity consists of actual invariant component orbit sums, not merely their rational span.

## Global line bundle and degree

A generic trivialization of J_D supplies a rational section whose divisor is vertical. Vanishing of all component degrees forces its local coefficient vector into the integral radical Zm. Hence J_D is genuinely pulled back from the base; no Picard-torsion or numerical-to-linear inference is omitted. Restriction to the zero section makes base pullback injective.

Choose h so that hQ is narrow everywhere. Translation by hQ fixes the literal correction divisor. The h-fold telescope therefore reduces to the already proved narrow-translation height formula, and gives h*degree(J_D)=h*ab/d0. This establishes the necessity of d0 dividing ab and the exact degree. The local Smith solutions construct a global correction for every permitted residue pair, proving sufficiency.

The punctured monodromy comparison also passes: the canonical trivialization of O(D) off the singular fibres telescopes in the h-fold contracting generator. Its long period is gamma_h=h gamma. Therefore S=diag(1,1,1,h) gives A_h=S^{-1} A S; the narrow case with weights h*w forces exactly D.GI2 for A. This asserts no cover of a filled cap.

## Independent execution

`code/fourfolds_vertical_correction_audit.py` writes only its own audit records. Exit0; output `records/fourfolds_vertical_correction_audit.out`. It checks all227 local pairs, including Smith unimodularity and literal solutions, all5696 profile residues, all82 actual elliptic monodromy/section cocycle orders against the recorded component groups, and all16 additional height-one section pairs. The actual generator residues are units and their component-group orders have lcm d0 in every profile. These finite periodic data prove the statement for every integer a,b.

## Additional simply connected initial data

A separate retained executable, `code/fourfolds_corrected_Mumford_examples.py`, uses only multiplicative Mumford caps and the proved punctured comparison. All16 cases pass: OS45/default with (a,b)=(2,4) or(4,2), one simple zero at any of the four I1 sites, and ordinary clutch e=+1 or-1. The exact unsaturated normal closure kills the entire vertical lattice; the remaining gamma generator is killed primitively, so the full fundamental group is trivial. H2=H3=Z4 in the first case and Z2 in the second, with no free middle groups and Euler2. The complete marked matrices are retained in `records/fourfolds_corrected_Mumford_examples.json`. No claim is made that new initial tuples necessarily yield new diffeomorphism types. The original corrected caps remain outside this calculation.

recorded_checks.scope:
# Independent audit of the OS45 primitive lattice and full fundamental-class calculation

Auditor: fourfolds. Scope: the marked OS45/default datum P=2G, Q=8G,
whole-fibre weights (2,0,0,0,0), ordinary clutch e=1, with the specified
Mumford caps. This audit does not determine the separate refined framing
class P.

## Conclusion

The complete proof in `code/maps_weighted_os45_mu_proof.tex` passes.
The essential correction is the literal degree-two core cochain, not merely
its functional on ordinary homology. The full cusp boundary comparison then
retains the coefficient-extension ambiguity. The primitive lattice and
localization inputs in `sections/fourfolds_OS45_cubic.tex` and
`sections/fourfolds_OS45_localization.tex` are consistent with it.

## Integral and finite-coefficient checks

1. The graph-cycle subgroup K is primitive because it is the kernel of an
   integral map. Its retained integral left inverse extends the graph row to
   the complete degree-two chain group. The fibre row is (1,0,0,0,0,0).
   The resulting cochain annihilates every degree-three boundary modulo eight.
   Thus it chooses an actual cohomology class even though the core has
   nonzero Ext(H1,Z/8). The zero fibre degree-three boundaries may be omitted
   from the stored nonzero-boundary matrix without changing this assertion.
2. At the cusp the four basis-loop quadratic prism corrections vanish.
   The actual peripheral graph map gives (0,52,0,148), so both long-strip
   constants are four modulo eight. This checks the constant terms as well
   as the alternating fibre form.
3. The boundary group is the actual split extension Z^3 semidirect L:
   the two short angular loops and theta form the normal Z^3, and the
   commuting long loops give the specified splitting. In total degree two,
   the restriction kernel is an extension of H^1(L;Aff) by H^2(L;k).
   The possible transgression to H^2(L;k) vanishes because of the splitting;
   H^3(L;-) vanishes because L has cohomological dimension two. Restriction
   to the actual long torus splits the left term. This argument is valid
   over Z/8, not only over a field.
4. On the simply connected cusp cover, relative component cochains are all
   functions on the vertex lattice, and the boundary connecting map is the
   three-dimensional space of affine functions. Equivalently, dualizing
   the free-quotient sequence I^2 -> Z[Z^2] -> Z^3 proves the same
   Functions/Aff description over Z/8. A quasiperiodic support descends
   because H^1 of the cover is zero and H^3(L;k)=0. Its choices differ by
   H^2(L;k). The affine differences (-r+4,4), together with long-torus
   value zero, therefore determine and match the whole boundary class.
5. The four other primitive rank-one caps and the ordinary cap have free
   boundary H1. Their fibre specialization surjects onto cap H2. Hence
   annihilating the retained full kernel columns gives equality of the
   entire boundary cohomology class there; no Ext ambiguity remains.
6. The global class has a unit value on the order-eight torsion generator.
   Free homology lifts can be adjusted by that generator to be annihilated
   by the class, giving the stated splitting of H2.

## Cup products and operations

The relative Bockstein calculation establishes the actual index-two
component overlattice, with 2y equal to the odd-component sum. Its
restrictions y|P_(r,s)=(-1)^s(H-E1) determine the integral primitive cubic.
No finite-coefficient division by two is used. The support gives all
component mixed products. The semicfree scalar circle action and its
sixteen fixed curves give the remaining evaluations directly:

- u^3=0 in Z/8;
- P2(u)y=0 in Z/16;
- uy^2=0 in Z/8.

The all-character polynomial identities verify that changing either
global equivariant lift does not change these values. Thomas's integral
lift identity is applied only on the fixed-curve products, where such
integral lifts exist. The resulting coordinates cover every summand of
H6(K(Z^15 plus Z/8,2);Z): the free cubic, 120 order-eight mixed coordinates,
15 order-sixteen Pontryagin-square coordinates, and the pure order-eight
coordinate. Thus this is the full fundamental-class invariant, not only
ordinary triple cup products. The primitive torsion coordinate also
detects the torsion part of y^2, proving y^2=0 integrally.

## Executed verification and layout

Independent replay of `code/maps_weighted_os45_mu.py` exited zero. It
verified the literal core cochain, cycle restriction, degree-three closure,
affine constants, all sixteen wall restrictions, opposite-wall gluing,
the shifted annulus evaluations [[9,24],[0,0]], and every stored primitive
mixed coordinate. Its reduced character representatives give raw
localization integers -1560,208,-32; these have the same required residues
as the unreduced representatives -16632,672,-32 in the independent
fourfolds localization program.

The primitive-cubic program separately verifies all 3375 primitive triples
and all 4096 recovered component triples. The local two-pass TeX build
passed after correcting a literal cases line-break typo; the first failed
build was a typesetting error, not an arithmetic failure. No unresolved
references or overfull boxes remain in that local build.

The refined class P remains outside this audit until the actual odd
middle-dimensional generator, reference framing, and critical-curve
linking have been evaluated. Neither the even regular-torus image nor
even coefficients in a bar-chain expression alone determine that parity.

own_check.details: Read the complete 94-line proof. Independently checked the canonical transition form, the two finite ramification orders, and the node residue, giving K^12=g*O(-6). Re-derived the NS relations from the regular-zero and infinity monodromies and nonconstant mu; the primitive indefinite form excludes any abelian quotient on a very general fibre. Meromorphic descent follows from the transverse-disc pole bound. Checked rationality of the ordinary double point by the positive conormal powers and formal functions, and then flat-family semicontinuity plus Euler characteristic gives (h00,h01,h02,h03)=(1,1,0,0). This closes the canonical-form dependency in D2.20.
